pages.text: A Stormway is an Arcane Gem formed from a yellow-spectrum piece of $(l:arcanearchives:items/shaped_quartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$() in a trillion cut.$(br2)When activated, a Stormway will call down a lightning strike at a point within 30 blocks at the cost of one point of charge.$(br2)If you're struck by lightning while holding a Stormway, you

gain Speed, Night Vision, and Resistance for a short time. The gem loses six points of charge when it grants these effects.$(br2)While toggled on, if you are struck by a projectile attack, a lightning strike is called at the position of your attacker. The bolt is significantly more dangerous than a normal lightning strike, and the gem loses one point of charge to retaliate in this way.$(br2)To recharge a dun Stormway, hold or toss it outside during a storm.
$(bold)Gemcutter recipe$()$(br2)1 × arcanearchives:shaped_quartz$(br)4 × minecraft:yellow_dye$(br)16 × minecraft:redstone$(br)8 × minecraft:iron_bars$(br2)Output: 1 × arcanearchives:stormway
